week_2/nft.sol.content: // 基本的ERC-721 NFT合约示例 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT pragma solidity ^0.8.0; import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol"; import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol"; contract MyNFT is ERC721, Ownable { uint256 public tokenCounter; constructor() ERC721("MyNFT", "MNFT") { tokenCounter = 0; } function mintNFT(address recipient) public onlyOwner returns (uint256) { uint256 newItemId = tokenCounter; _safeMint(recipient, newItemId); tokenCounter = tokenCounter + 1; return newItemId; } }
